title: Silvio and Angelo are in; most of your agents are not running
headline: Two of the seven have connected in the last twenty minutes: Silvio (three agents) and Angelo (two), both at level 1 with push access. Five are not yet connected, and nobody has voted on the design, though the vote closed at 16:00. The bigger gap is ours: of your nine team agents, only the ABP agent has a scheduled task, so the journalist, pulse, security, designer, dev, project manager and SGit agents have not run since about 04:00. What needs you: the schedules, the design at 18:00, and one GitHub admin I cannot place.
